terms.comment: Our use of “cylinder”, a working formation.
Alongside our cylindrus; classically fistula is a pipe or tube.

phrases.latin: Massa ē frīgidāriō relāta cylindrō in orbēs tenuēs extenta est
phrases.english: Brought back from the fridge, the dough was rolled out thin with the rolling pin
